politique_en:
INVESTMENT UNIVERSE
The fund mainly invests in bonds, including bonds with low ratings, issued by governments (or related bodies) in the emerging markets and denominated in any currency. The fund may use derivatives in order to take advantage of or hedge against market fluctuations, or for efficient portfolio management. In the active management of the fund, the manager selects securities with the potential for an advantageous return in relation to the risk incurred on the basis of criteria that are both financial and related to sustainable development (such as, for example, respect for the environment or socially equitable governance). The sub-fund is actively managed and no benchmark is used.
